blocking: 灰蒙蒙的流沙河边，悟空立于岸上居中靠前，唐僧、八戒立于岸侧稍后；浑黄急流横在画面下方。
soundscape: 流沙河浊浪翻滚的水声，河岸风声，悟空投石的入水轻响
music: 弦声沉沉压住，前路被水断开的凝重
soundscapeEn: The rolling muddy torrent of the Flowing-sand River, the wind on the bank, and the light splash of the stone.
musicEn: Strings pressing low, the road cut off by water.

cuts.frame: 全景：灰蒙蒙的流沙河边，浑黄的河水卷着白沫急急奔流，把去路拦腰斩断。悟空立在岸边望着水直皱眉。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，阴晦的天光下浑黄河水卷着白沫奔流，矮小的猴军立在岸边望着水面皱眉。
cuts.body: a static wide shot of the muddy torrent rolling with white foam across the grey river, the short monkey on the bank frowning at the water

cuts.frame: 中景：悟空弯腰捡起一块石头，扬手投进河里，起了个水漂，眨眼就被浊浪吞没。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，岸边的猴军弯腰拾起一块石头扬手投进河，起了一个水漂，转眼被浊浪吞没。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the monkey picking up a stone and skimming it into the river, the splash swallowed in an instant

cuts.frame: 特写：悟空望着河面皱眉开口，说这河又急又浑连个船影都没有，可怎么过去。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，望水的猴军皱眉开口，说这河又急又浑、连船影都寻不着。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the monkey frowning at the current, saying the river is too swift and muddied, with no boat in sight

blocking: 唐僧立于悟空身侧居中，八戒在另一侧；三人一并望着河面商量渡河。
soundscape: 唐僧缓声的劝慰，八戒摩拳擦掌的响动，河水依旧奔流
music: 弦声短暂松弛，寻计渡河的商量
soundscapeEn: The monk's calm words, the second man's eager stirring, and the river rushing on.
musicEn: Strings briefly easing, planning the crossing.

cuts.frame: 中景：唐僧在旁温声开口，劝悟空莫急，先看看有无渡桥或舟船。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，立在旁的僧人温声开口，劝那猴军莫急，先寻渡桥或舟船。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the robed monk speaking gently, urging patience and a search for a bridge or boat

cuts.frame: 中景：八戒拍拍肚子接过话，说自己会凫水，先下水替众人探探深浅。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，那黑粗壮的汉子摩拳擦掌接过话，说自己颇会凫水，要下水探深浅。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the burly dark man volunteering, confident in his swimming, to sound the water first

blocking: 悟空与八戒相对而立，唐僧在中间侧望；两人斗嘴，八戒摩挲着就要下水。
soundscape: 悟空打趣的话音，八戒不服的应答，河水在旁奔流
music: 弦声轻快带揶揄，师兄弟的水性之争
soundscapeEn: The monkey's teasing, the burly man's held-off reply, and the river running nearby.
musicEn: Strings light with teasing, a contest over swimming.

cuts.frame: 特写：悟空抱棒打趣，说你那一身膘掉下去怕是要沉底喂鱼。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，抱棒的猴军扬声打趣，揶揄那壮汉一身膘掉水里怕要喂鱼。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the monkey teasing that the man's heft would sink him to feed the fish

cuts.frame: 特写：八戒不服回嘴，说自己水性是实打实的。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，壮汉不服回嘴，硬说自己这一身水性是实打实的。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the burly man retorting that his swimming is the genuine article

blocking: 八戒扑通跳入浊流居于河心偏右，悟空立于岸上；河心猛地翻起巨浪。
soundscape: 八戒入水的扑通声，河心巨浪翻起的水声，黑影蹿起的浪响
music: 鼓点猛然砸下，下水即惊变
soundscapeEn: The splash of the dive, the great surge of a wave at mid-stream, and the rush of a dark shape leaping.
musicEn: A heavy drumfall as the water turns violent at once.

cuts.frame: 全景：八戒扑通跳入浊流，刚游出两步，河心猛地翻起一个老高的巨浪。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，那黑粗壮的汉子扑通跳入浊流才游出两步，河心猛地翻起一个老高的巨浪。
cuts.body: a static wide shot of the burly man diving into the muddy current, only to have a towering wave rear up mid-river

cuts.frame: 中景：一条黑影从浪里蹿起，一把拽住八戒的腿，直往深水底下拖。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，一条黑影自浪头蹿起，一把拽住水中壮汉的腿，直往深水底下拖。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of a dark shape bursting from the wave to seize the swimmer's leg, hauling him down into the deep

blocking: 八戒在河心被拖入水只露头，悟空自岸上一个筋斗跃下；他捞起八戒甩回岸上。
soundscape: 八戒入水的呼救，悟空跃水的破声，甩人上岸的水花
music: 弦声一紧一放，抢救上岸
soundscapeEn: The swimmer's cry, the monkey leaping in, and the splash as the man is hurled ashore.
musicEn: Strings tightening then relaxing as the rescue lands him dry.

cuts.frame: 特写：八戒被拖只露出头，挣扎呼喊，说有什么东西咬住了自己，快救人。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，被拖入水的黑粗壮汉挣扎着只露出头，扬声呼喊有东西咬住自己、快救人。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the burly man struggling, head above water, crying that something has seized him

cuts.frame: 中景：悟空看势头不对，一个筋斗跃下河，把八戒拦腰一捞甩手掷回岸上。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，见势不妙的猴军一个筋斗跃下河，拦腰一捞把壮汉甩手掷回岸上。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the monkey leaping in and, catching the man round the middle, hurling him back onto the bank

blocking: 八戒爬上岸居右，悟空立于岸侧居左，两人一并望着那浑河；八戒咳出几口水。
soundscape: 八戒爬岸的粗喘，他咳出河水的声，悟空在旁问话
music: 弦声重新落定，探河无果的收束
soundscapeEn: The man scrambling ashore, coughing up river water, and the monkey's query beside him.
musicEn: Strings settling again, the probe that came to nothing.

cuts.frame: 全景：八戒爬上岸，咳出几口水，惊魂未定地回头望着那浑河。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，那黑粗壮汉爬上岸咳出几口水，惊魂未定地回头望着身后的浑河。
cuts.body: a static wide shot of the burly man scrambling ashore and coughing, glancing back at the river with lingering shock

cuts.frame: 特写：八戒一抹嘴角喘着气说，那东西力气大得出奇，拽着就往河底拖。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，爬上岸的壮汉一抹嘴角喘着气说，那东西力气奇大，一路把他拖向河底。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the burly man wiping his mouth and gasping that the thing's strength was immense, dragging him to the bottom

blocking: 悟空立于岸上拍棒就要下水，唐僧在旁急忙伸手拦住他。
soundscape: 悟空不屑他的话声，唐僧伸手拦阻的衣响，河水奔流
music: 弦声一扬，悟空要亲自会一会
soundscapeEn: The monkey's scoffing, the rustle of the monk reaching to stay him, and the running river.
musicEn: Strings lifting as the monkey sets out to face it.

cuts.frame: 特写：悟空不屑应声，说瞧你那点出息，自己去会会水里的东西。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，岸上的猴军不屑应声，说要去会会水里的东西。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the monkey scoffing and declaring he will go face whatever lurks in the water

cuts.frame: 中景：唐僧在旁看得心惊，忙伸手拦住悟空，劝他莫要贸然下水。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，心惊的僧人忙伸手拦住那猴军，劝他莫要贸然下水。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the alarmed monk reaching out to stay the monkey, urging him not to plunge in rashly

blocking: 悟空立于岸边亮棒，唐僧在侧欲拦；河心又翻大浪，黑影探出半截身直逼岸边。
soundscape: 悟空应声的话音，河中翻浪的水声，黑影逼近的潜响
music: 弦声猛然拔高，妖物再次冒头
soundscapeEn: The monkey's answer, the surge of another wave, and the approaching rumble of the dark shape.
musicEn: Strings leaping, the monster surfacing again.

cuts.frame: 特写：悟空扬声宽慰，说自己自会水，岂怕它几个浪头。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，岸边的猴军扬声宽慰，说自己是水性再好不过，岂怕它几个浪头。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the monkey reassuring, unafraid of a few waves

cuts.frame: 全景：悟空才要下水，河中又翻一道大浪，那黑影探出半截身直逼岸边。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，猴军正要下水，河中又翻一道大浪，一条黑影探出半截身直逼到他跟前。
cuts.body: a static wide shot as another wave rises and a dark shape leans half out of the water, bearing straight toward the bank

blocking: 悟空亮出金箍棒虚晃一棒，转身往岸上跑；那黑影自浪中踏水直追。
soundscape: 悟空亮棒虚晃的破风，他转身跑动的脚步，黑影踏浪的水声
music: 鼓点两句紧追，引蛇出洞的计策
soundscapeEn: The whoosh of the feint, the monkey's footsteps as he runs, and the splash of the shape giving chase.
musicEn: Drums hot on his heels, the bait taken.

cuts.frame: 全景：悟空眼珠一转，亮出金箍棒朝那黑影虚晃一棒，转身就往岸上跑。
cuts.shot: 跟拍，猴军眼珠一转，亮棒朝那条黑影虚晃一记，转身就往岸上跑。
cuts.body: a tracking wide shot of the monkey feinting his staff at the dark shape, then turning and making for the bank

cuts.frame: 特写：悟空边跑边扬声叫阵，说就让那怪物追来，自己好腾出手收拾它。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，奔跑中的猴军回身扬声叫阵，诱那水中怪物追来，好腾手收拾。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the monkey calling back over his shoulder, baiting the river creature to give chase

blocking: 那黑影自浪中哗地蹿出，扑上岸现出真身居于画面右；悟空立于左侧备棒。
soundscape: 黑影破浪蹿出的水声，它扑上岸的沉重落地，悟空备棒的轻响
music: 鼓点一顿，妖物正式现形
soundscapeEn: The creature bursting from the surf, its heavy landing on the bank, and the monkey readying his staff.
musicEn: A drum holds still as the monster reveals itself.

cuts.frame: 全景：那黑影果然大怒，哗地从浪里蹿出整个人扑上岸来，现出真身。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，那条黑影果然大怒，哗地破浪蹿出，整个人扑上岸来现出真身。
cuts.body: a static wide shot of the enraged dark shape bursting from the waves and hurling itself ashore to show its true form

cuts.frame: 中景：那现形的青脸妖汉立定怒喝，说敢在自己河里叫嚣，休想活着走。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，现出原形的青脸妖汉立定怒喝，扬言今番别想活着离开。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the revealed beast, an azure-faced figure, shouting that none may speak boldly in his river and live

blocking: 悟空绕跑一段回身抡棒居左，妖汉持械居右；沙岸上缠斗几个来回。
soundscape: 悟空回身抡棒的破风，两人缠斗的脚步，被拍翻倒地的闷响
music: 鼓点密成一阵，缠斗推向压制
soundscapeEn: The swish of the staff, the scuffle of the fight, and the dull thud of the foe brought down.
musicEn: Drums running thick, the struggle tipping into a takedown.

cuts.frame: 全景：悟空跑出一段猛地回身抡棒就迎上去，把那人扫了个趔趄。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，猴军跑出一段猛地回身抡棒迎上，把那青脸妖汉扫了个趔趄。
cuts.body: a static wide shot of the monkey whirling round to sweep his staff at the foe, sending the creature staggering

cuts.frame: 中景：两人在沙岸上缠斗几个来回，那人渐渐落下风，被悟空一掌拍翻在地。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，沙岸上两人缠斗几个来回，那青脸妖汉渐渐落下风，被猴军一掌拍翻在地。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the pair trading blows before the creature is overpowered and struck down by a single palm

blocking: 悟空上前一脚踩住妖汉背脊居左，低头看他颈前的骷髅串；妖汉趴地居右。
soundscape: 悟空踩住背脊的压实声，妖汉的低喘，他颈上骷髅串的轻响
music: 弦声一沉，战后的盘问
soundscapeEn: The foot pressing down, the creature's low breathing, and the faint rattle of the skull beads at his neck.
musicEn: Strings settling low for the interrogation.

cuts.frame: 特写：悟空上前一脚踩住他背脊，低头一瞧见颈上挂着一串骷髅珠，不由一怔。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，猴军一脚踩住那青脸妖汉的背脊，低头瞧见他颈上一串骷髅珠，不由一怔。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the monkey planting a foot on the creature's back and pausing at the skull beads strung at its neck

cuts.frame: 特写：悟空沉声追问，问他到底是何方妖物，为何颈上挂着这种东西。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，踩定背脊的猴军沉声追问，问那妖汉的来历与颈上骷髅的缘由。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the monkey pressing him low, demanding to know what creature he is and why the skulls hang round his neck

blocking: 悟空踩定背脊俯身听，妖汉趴地低头自述身世；唐僧走近岸侧倾听。
soundscape: 妖汉趴地沉声自述，悟空俯身细听，岸边河水奔流
music: 弦声转悲凉，一段被贬的身世
soundscapeEn: The creature's grave account from the ground, the monkey listening close, and the river running below.
musicEn: Strings turning plaintive, a banished past told.

cuts.frame: 中景：那妖汉趴地低头自述，说自己本是天宫卷帘大将，因打碎琉璃盏被贬下界。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，趴地的青脸妖汉低头自述，说自己原是天上卷帘一职，因砸碎琉璃盏被贬落到此间。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the azure-faced creature recounting from the ground how he served as a curtain-bearer in heaven until breaking a jade cup and being banished

cuts.frame: 中景：唐僧走近岸侧，合掌轻叹，说原是仙班中人，何苦在此以吃人为生。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，走近岸侧的僧人合掌轻叹，说既是仙班中人，何苦在此以吃人为生。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the monk sighing with joined hands, asking why a once-celestial being would live by devouring men

blocking: 唐僧立于妖汉身前俯视，妖汉趴地抬头回话；悟空在侧踩定背脊。
soundscape: 妖汉无力的诉苦，唐僧温声的往开导，河水的呜咽
music: 弦声低回，一丝归正的微光
soundscapeEn: The creature's helpless lament, the monk's gentle guidance, and the river's low wail.
musicEn: Strings low and turning, a faint light of amendment.

cuts.frame: 特写：那妖汉抬头无力地诉苦，说自己不能回天，不吃人又能靠什么活命。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，抬头的青脸妖汉无力诉苦，说自己回不去天界，不吃人又靠什么活命。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the creature lifting his head to lament that, unable to return to heaven, devouring men is all he knows for survival

cuts.frame: 中景：唐僧温声说，你若肯洗心，贫僧倒愿意带你走一条归正的路。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，僧人温声许诺，说若肯洗心革面，自己愿意引他走一条归正的路。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the monk speaking gently, promising to guide the creature onto a righteous path if he will turn from evil

blocking: 妖汉趴地自嫌罪业，悟空在侧欲发作；话未落，天边云开一线、金光落在河上。
soundscape: 妖汉低沉的应话，悟空欲发作的怒喝，天边金光的异响
music: 弦声骤然荡开，神明显圣的转场
soundscapeEn: The creature's low reply, the monkey's rising indignation, and the strange chime of golden light over the river.
musicEn: Strings sweeping open, a divine intercession.

cuts.frame: 特写：那妖汉低头苦笑，说自己一身罪业，怕是连路都要压塌。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，低头的青脸妖汉苦笑，说自己罪业太重，恐怕连道都要压垮。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the creature smiling bitterly, saying his accumulating sins would crush even a path

cuts.frame: 全景：悟空在旁看不下去正要发作，话音未落天边忽地云开一线，一道金光落在河上。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，鹊起的猴军正要发作，天边却忽然云开一线，一道金光灿然落在河上。
cuts.body: a static wide shot as the monkey moves to speak, only for the clouds to part and shaft of golden light to fall upon the river

blocking: 金光中观音踏浪立于河心居画面偏上，众人立于河岸仰望；妖汉仍趴地。
soundscape: 河面金光盈盈，观音踏浪的字音，河岸众人屏息的静
music: 弦声转空灵庄严，观世音显圣
soundscapeEn: The golden gleam on the water, the goddess stepping on the waves, and the hush of the watchers ashore.
musicEn: Strings turning ethereal and solemn, the bodhisattva manifest.

cuts.frame: 全景：观音自金光中显出身形，踏浪立在河心，须臾现出真容。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，一道金光中现出一道雍容女相，踏浪立在河心，须臾显真容。
cuts.body: a static wide shot of a radiant goddess stepping out of the golden light to stand upon the river's heart

cuts.frame: 中景：观音端立河心，声音慈和，唤那妖汉悟净，说他罪业在身，皈依方可赎了这一难。
cuts.shot: 固定机位居于河上略高，那位雍容女相声音慈和，唤妖汉的名号，说他罪业在身，皈依取经方得赎难。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the goddess speaking gently over the water, calling the creature to repent and redeem his sin by following the pilgrim west

blocking: 妖汉跪伏于地抬头许愿皈依，八戒在侧喜上眉梢；众人围拢。
soundscape: 妖汉皈依的应声，八戒在旁鼓动的笑音，河面金光渐收
music: 弦声转暖，皈依之愿落定
soundscapeEn: The creature's vow to take refuge, the sliding man's cheerful urging, and the golden light receding.
musicEn: Strings warming, the vow of refuge made.

cuts.frame: 特写：那妖汉跪伏抬头，应声愿皈依，求菩萨指一条明路。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，抬头跪伏的青脸妖汉应声，说愿皈依，求那位女相指条明路。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the azure-faced creature kneeling to vow refuge, asking the goddess to show the way

cuts.frame: 中景：八戒在旁喜上眉梢，催师弟快些拜了师父，好过河赶路。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，立在旁的黑粗壮汉喜上眉梢，催新师弟赶紧拜师，好过河赶路。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the burly dark man grinning and hurrying the new junior disciple to take his vows so they may cross and ride on

blocking: 沙僧起身走到唐僧面前双膝跪下，接过一支月牙铲担在肩头；唐僧立定受拜。
soundscape: 沙僧起身跪步的衣响，月牙铲到手的轻响，唐僧受拜的静
music: 弦声庄重落定，拜师之仪完成
soundscapeEn: The rustle of rising and kneeling, the moon-scraper staff taken in hand, and the quiet of the master receiving the bow.
musicEn: Strings settling solemn, the ceremony of homage completed.

cuts.frame: 全景：沙僧起身走到唐僧面前双膝跪下，接过一支月牙铲担在肩头。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，那青脸汉子起身走到僧人面前双膝跪下，接过一支月牙铲担上肩头。
cuts.focus: 锁定跪接月牙铲的动作
cuts.body: a static wide shot of the azure-faced man walking before the monk, kneeling on both knees, and taking a moon-blade staff onto his shoulder

cuts.frame: 中景：沙僧跪地低头，自称悟净拜见师父，说自己一路替他挑担驯马。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，跪地的青脸汉子低头自称，说从此为师父挑担驯马。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the azure-faced man kneeling low and announcing himself, ready to bear loads and tend the horse for his master

blocking: 沙僧拜师后立起，八戒在旁打量，唐僧居中颔首；众人望向河面准备渡河。
soundscape: 沙僧允诺的沉稳，八戒在旁打趣的笑音，河水奔流
music: 弦声轻快，同伴渐齐的和乐
soundscapeEn: The steady promise of the new disciple, the sliding man's jest, and the river running on.
musicEn: Strings light, the camaraderie of a growing band.

cuts.frame: 中景：沙僧直起身应声，说往后挑担打水跑腿喂马，全交给自己。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，立定的青脸汉子沉声应下，说往后挑担打水、跑腿喂马的活计都归他。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the azure-faced man standing tall and answering that henceforth all the fetching, watering and stable work is his

cuts.frame: 中景：八戒在旁咧嘴打趣，说又多一个给自己扛行李的，感情好。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，旁立的黑粗壮汉咧嘴打趣，说多一个替自己扛行李的朋友是桩美事。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the burly dark man grinning, glad to have another pair of hands to share the load

blocking: 唐僧居中颔首目望，八戒、沙僧分列两侧，悟空在旁；众人望着河面。
soundscape: 唐僧感慰的话音，众人整装渡河的动静，河水由急转平
music: 弦声回暖上扬，师徒四人齐了
soundscapeEn: The monk's grateful words, the stir of the party preparing, and the river easing.
musicEn: Strings warming and rising, the four disciples now complete.

cuts.frame: 中景：唐僧感慰颔首，说自此师徒四人再加那匹白龙马，一队人总算是齐了。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，僧人感慰颔首，说自此师徒四人再加那匹坐骑，一支队伍总算齐了。
cuts.body: a static medium shot of the monk nodding with quiet relief that master, three disciples and the steed together make a full company

cuts.frame: 全景：唐僧领着众人转向河滩，寻了处浅处，一齐涉水过了流沙河。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，僧人领着众人转向河滩寻了处浅处，一行人涉水过了流沙河。
cuts.body: a static wide shot of the monk leading the party to a shallow spot, all wading across the Flowing-sand River

blocking: 沙僧挑行李居左跟在马后，悟空在前引路居右，唐僧骑马居中；一行人上了对岸。
soundscape: 沙僧挑担的沉稳脚步，悟空带笑的话音，上岸后衣摆滴水
music: 弦声轻快，过了河的松快
soundscapeEn: The steady step of the load-bearer, the monkey's cheerful tone, and the drip of water after the crossing.
musicEn: Strings light, the ease of being across.

cuts.frame: 全景：沙僧把行李挑上肩，稳稳跟在马后，落后半步不紧不慢。
cuts.shot: 固定机位，那青脸汉子把行李挑上肩，稳稳跟在马后落后半步，不紧不慢。
cuts.body: a static wide shot of the azure-faced man hefting the load onto his shoulder and pacing steadily half a step behind the horse

cuts.frame: 特写：悟空在前头侧头勉励，说老沙你沉得住性子，往后遇事咱俩好生商量。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，前头引路的猴军侧头扬声勉励，说这新师弟性子沉稳，往后有事好生商量。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the monkey glancing back to encourage the steady junior, saying they should always counsel together

blocking: 沙僧居左挑担随行，唐僧骑马居中，悟空在右引路；黄昏河边四人一马朝西而行。
soundscape: 沙僧恭顺的应答，马蹄与脚步相随，河水渐渐落在身后
music: 弦声舒展收远，取经队伍正式启程
soundscapeEn: The junior's respectful answer, the mingled fall of hooves and feet, and the river receding behind.
musicEn: Strings widening, the pilgrim company setting out.

cuts.frame: 特写：沙僧低声应诺，说全凭师兄与师父吩咐。
cuts.shot: 固定机位贴着他，挑担随行的青脸汉子低声应诺，把听从师兄师父吩咐的话说得诚恳。
cuts.body: a static close-up on the azure-faced man answering low and humbly, ready to follow his elders' bidding

cuts.frame: 全景：黄昏的河边，四人一马过了岸，顺着前路缓缓往西行去。
cuts.shot: 跟拍，黄昏的河岸上四人一马过了岸，顺着前路缓缓朝西行去。
cuts.body: a tracking wide shot of the four and the horse making the far shore and moving slowly westward into the dusk
